title: Critical functions of L-selectin-mediated lymphocyte homing and recruitment
protocol: Fix lymph node frozen sections with acetone for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash the sections with PBS three times.

Incubate the fixed lymph node frozen sections with 100 mU/ml N-glycosidase F in a solution containing 10 mM HEPES-NaOH, pH 7.4, 0.1% Triton X-100, 0.1 M 2-mercaptoethanol and complete protease inhibitor at 37°C for 2 h.
Incubate the sections with 0.1 to 1 mg/ml O-sialoglycoprotein endopeptidase in 10 mM HEPES-NaOH, pH 7.4, at 37°C for 2 h.
Incubate the sections with 25 mU/ml Heparitinase I and II and heparinase in a solution containing PBS, 1 mg/ml BSA, 1 mM CaCl₂ and protease inhibitor at 37°C for 2 h.
Wash the digested sections with PBS containing 0.1 mg/ml BSA at least three times.
Perform standard immunostaining technique using antibodies specific for appropriate glycans to evaluate the digestions.
Conduct lectin staining including L/E/P-selectin-IgM staining as applicable.
